comment: The bi-polar button is not a separate output stage: PEGChannel.h:141 uses it to drive the firmware's offset control to half scale when it is down and full scale when it is up. The panel's SCALE knobs are configured as -100% to +100% attenuverters (PEG_info.hh:22 and PEG_info.hh:29) but PEGChannel.h:140 passes the parameter straight through as 0 to 1, so they attenuate and never invert. The two CV inputs marked CV IN on each side feed the firmware's pot readings rather than its CV readings: PEGChannel.h:151-152 hold the firmware's own CV inputs at their zero value. The source notes at PEGChannel.h:182 that the ping input's low-pass filtering has not been modelled.
